title: Orphix (Mission)/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Cephalon Cy: "Orphix Sentients have overrun that Corpus cap ship. Corpus ship but in our house. This has become an us problem."
- Cephalon Cy: "Corpus capital ship has become a staging platform for Orphix Sentients. Remedy this."
- Cephalon Cy: "On screen, Corpus cap ship. Massive Sentient readings. Pack Necramechs. Whatever is on there can never be allowed off."
- Cephalon Cy: "Sentient presense at zero. Walk away in slow motion. Orchestra swells."
- Cephalon Cy: "Orphix pulses have flatlined. Nice. Moving on."
